articlesLead: The problems people write to us about most, and what fixes them.

articles.title: The mail server rejects my password
articles.summary: Almost always the wrong password or username. Use the mailbox's own login.
articles.keywords: imap smtp password rejected wrong login username cpanel plesk hosting own domain auth failed
steps: Use the mailbox password, not your hosting or control panel login.
Use the full email address as the username.
If the mailbox has two-factor sign-in, use an app password.
Reset the password where your host lists email accounts (cPanel: Email Accounts).
Check the server names against our provider guides.

articles.title: App password needed (Yahoo, iCloud, Gmail, Zoho)
articles.summary: These providers refuse your normal password here. Create an app password and paste it.
articles.keywords: app password app-specific application-specific yahoo icloud apple gmail google zoho 2-step verification
steps: Yahoo: Account Security, then Generate app password.
iCloud: account.apple.com, Sign-In and Security, then App-Specific Passwords.
Gmail: turn on 2-Step Verification, then visit myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.
Zoho: create an application-specific password, and turn IMAP on in Zoho Mail settings.
Paste it as shown. Spaces are ignored.

articles.title: Yandex: IMAP access is switched off
articles.summary: Yandex refuses mail apps until IMAP is on. It looks like a wrong password.
articles.keywords: yandex imap disabled off app password mail clients yandex 360
steps: In Yandex Mail, open Settings, then Mail clients.
Enable IMAP access, plus app passwords and OAuth tokens.
At id.yandex.com, create an app password of type Mail.
Connect with your full address and that app password.

articles.title: Connected, but the assistant sees no mail
articles.summary: The mailbox is connected, but your assistant says it has no email tools or finds nothing.
articles.keywords: no tools nothing empty connector not working claude chatgpt cursor developer mode scope inbox_list plugin @
steps: Open Inboxes in the dashboard and check that the mailbox is listed without an error. If it shows one, reconnect it.

Start a new chat after adding the connector. In Claude, check that MCPEmails is switched on under + and Connectors. In ChatGPT, type @ and pick MCPEmails, and @mention it again when a follow-up needs your mail.
Authorize the connector with the same MCPEmails account that holds the mailbox.
Your assistant only sees the tools your connector or API key is scoped for. If you left a scope unticked, remove the connector and add it again.
Ask the assistant to list your inboxes first. Mail is fetched when the assistant asks for it, so nothing arrives on its own.

articles.title: Usage limit reached
articles.summary: Free includes 150 email actions a month. After that, actions wait until the 1st (UTC).
articles.keywords: usage limit allowance cap 150 actions free plan refused reset quota
steps: See how many actions you have used under Usage in the dashboard.
Listing your inboxes and anything you do in the dashboard are never counted, and nothing is counted in your first 3 days after signup.
Retrying does not help. The allowance resets on the 1st of the next month (UTC), and paused automations resume on their own.
Personal, Pro and Business have unlimited email actions, subject to fair use.
Workspaces created before 2026-09-12 are not metered. If you see the limit on one of those, write to us.

articles.title: Change or cancel your plan
articles.summary: Change or cancel any time in Settings, under Billing & plan.
articles.keywords: plan upgrade downgrade cancel subscription billing invoice refund stripe portal payment card
steps: Open Settings, then Billing & plan.
Choose Manage billing to cancel, change your card or get invoices.
Cancelling stops renewal. You keep your plan until the period ends.
Unexpected first charge? Write to us within 14 days for a full refund.

articles.title: Disconnect a mailbox or delete your account
articles.summary: Remove one mailbox, one workspace or your whole account from the dashboard.
articles.keywords: disconnect remove inbox mailbox delete account workspace close danger zone
steps: Mailbox: in Inboxes, click it and choose Disconnect. Its stored credential is removed.
Workspace: in Settings, under Workspace, choose Delete workspace.
Account: in Settings, under Danger zone, choose Delete account. This cannot be undone.
Deleting the account cancels a paid plan at once, with no refund.
To use the time you paid for, cancel first and delete later.
